verdict.rationale: Buzz does ship in-chat workflows: they can be run from the relay, have CLI trigger and approve commands, and their runs are searchable alongside conversations. However, the only description of how workflows are authored is "YAML-as-code automation," which is code-defined rather than no-code. Missing for 10: a no-code or visual workflow builder, documented event-based triggers, schedule/cron triggers, form-submission triggers, and admin-facing authoring docs or hands-on corroboration.
